messages:
maria: Quick sync — hotpath perf sprint update. Canary build 2026-03-16-rc4 showing a ~15% p95 tail bump when the KV cache does a 2nd-pass warmup. Seen this on region-us-west canary only so far. Anyone owning KV prefetch/policy? Need owners to triage before tomorrow's merge window.

alex: I can take initial triage. Which canary IDs and what traffic pattern? Also any flamegraphs? :eyes:

maria: thanks alex. Canary ID is canary-rc4-1187, generated from the daily perf job. Traffic: bursty chat replay (95th perc requests have long prefixes). Here's a snippet from the logs showing the KV miss spike at ~t+40s: 

```
2026-03-16T08:12:40Z [hotpath] kv.prefetch miss_count=42 latency_ms=18.7
2026-03-16T08:12:40Z [hotpath] kv.fetch batch_size=1 cpu_ms=3.2
2026-03-16T08:12:41Z [hotpath] kv.prefetch warmup_done=false
```

maria: Also flag: continuous-batching config was toggled to enable adaptive-window in this canary (batch.max_ms=8 -> 5). Could be interaction.

devon: tagging in case kernel/exec wants to weigh in — the pattern looks like small batch sizes causing extra KV round-trips. @alex can you paste the trace link?

alex: link: https://perf.redwood.internal/traces/canary-1187 (permissions: eng-runtime). The flame shows a hot path where kernel-spin waits on kv.fetch for several sequential calls. I opened a draft PR that reorders prefetch to be *ahead* of kernel schedule: https://git.redwood/infer/PR/5422. Needs review.

sam: quick Q: is the prefetch handshake using the new backpressure token? If not, we might be queuing more small batches. PR looked at that briefly — I left a comment re: token check in cbatch loop.

alex: PR currently adds a prefetch queue and issues prefetches for next N tokens. It doesn't yet integrate backpressure tokens — wanted to test behavior first. Devon, want me to add the token gate in same PR or follow-up?

devon: prefer follow-up to keep change size small. But we need an owner for follow-up. @jen are you OK owning the backpressure integration this sprint? It's small but blocks the mitigation.

jen: I can pick it up. ETA EOD tomorrow. I'll sync with alex on PR interface. I'll also add a canary that reverts adaptive-window to validate interaction.

maria: awesome. For tracking: milestone = sprint-hotpath-MAR3, owners: alex (triage + prefetch prototype), jen (backpressure integration), devon (kernel review), sam (observability + perf dashboards). Dependencies: runtime-kernel PR review, canary infra flakes.

sam: I'll add a dashboard panel for kv.prefetch miss_count + batch_size distribution and wire alert if p95 > 10ms for two consecutive windows. Also will add trace links to the incident card.

ci-bot: Deploy check: canary-rc4-1187 has 2/3 success healthchecks. Auto-roll disabled.

maria: ok good. Next steps: alex finishes triage, posts results here; jen adds token gate PR; devon does quick kernel API review (small changes). We aim to decide by 2026-03-17 18:00 PT whether to merge mitigation or roll back adaptive-window. If anything urgent pops up, ping #eng-oncall.

alex: ack. I'll post flame diffs and a small benchmark by EOD today.

jen: ack, will draft PR and link tests.

devon: will prioritize review.

maria: thanks team :thumbsup: keeping this thread open for async updates. If anyone finds a smoking root cause that's unrelated, please start a new thread with incident tags.
